description: Flat metadata schema for individual records describing monoclonal antibody screening data against cancer cell antigens, including production, purification, binding characterization, functional assays, and lead-candidate assessment.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or assay-result row.

antibody_name.descr: Human-readable antibody name or internal designation.

hybridoma_clone_id.descr: Identifier of the hybridoma clone used to produce the monoclonal antibody.

antibody_isotype.descr: Antibody isotype, for example IgG1, IgG2a, IgM.

antibody_species.descr: Species in which the monoclonal antibody was generated, for example mouse or rat.

heavy_chain_variable_region_sequence.descr: Heavy-chain variable region amino acid sequence, if available.

light_chain_variable_region_sequence.descr: Light-chain variable region amino acid sequence, if available.

target_antigen_name.descr: Name of the cancer cell antigen targeted by the antibody.

target_antigen_id.descr: Database or curated identifier for the target antigen, for example UniProt accession or gene symbol.

target_antigen_class.descr: Biological class of the target antigen, for example membrane protein, receptor, glycoprotein, or tumor-associated antigen.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer type associated with the target or assay system, for example breast cancer, melanoma, leukemia.

cell_line_name.descr: Cancer cell line used in binding or functional assays, for example MCF-7, HeLa, A549.

cell_line_id.descr: Cell line database identifier, if available, for example Cellosaurus accession.

cell_line_origin_species.descr: Species origin of the cell line, for example human, mouse.

antibody_production_method.descr: Method used to produce the antibody, expected value: hybridoma technology or equivalent hybridoma-derived production.

purification_method.descr: Method used to purify the antibody, for example Protein A, Protein G, ion exchange, affinity chromatography.

purity_percent.descr: Purity of the purified antibody in percent (%), typically from SDS-PAGE or analytical chromatography.

antibody_concentration_mg_ml.descr: Measured antibody concentration in milligrams per milliliter (mg/mL).

buffer_composition.descr: Buffer composition used during storage, purification, or assay preparation.

assay_type.descr: Primary assay type for the record, for example ELISA, flow cytometry, apoptosis assay, proliferation assay.

assay_platform.descr: Instrument or platform used, for example plate reader, flow cytometer model, imaging system.

assay_date.descr: Date on which the assay was performed.

assay_duration_h.descr: Assay incubation or measurement duration in hours (h).

antibody_dilution.descr: Working dilution of the antibody used in the assay, reported as dilution factor or ratio.

antibody_concentration_assay_ug_ml.descr: Antibody concentration used in the assay in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL).

antigen_concentration_ng_ml.descr: Antigen concentration used in binding assays in nanograms per milliliter (ng/mL), if applicable.

cell_density_cells_ml.descr: Cell density used in cellular assays in cells per milliliter (cells/mL), if applicable.

binding_affinity_kd_nM.descr: Equilibrium dissociation constant KD in nanomolar (nM), lower values indicate stronger binding.

binding_ec50_nM.descr: Half-maximal effective concentration EC50 in nanomolar (nM), if reported for binding assays.

binding_signal_od450.descr: ELISA optical density readout at 450 nm, if applicable.

binding_signal_mfi.descr: Mean fluorescence intensity from flow cytometry, if applicable.

binding_signal_percent_positive.descr: Percent of antigen-positive cells or antibody-positive events detected by flow cytometry or related binding assay.

specificity_score.descr: Quantitative measure of specificity, such as target-to-off-target binding ratio or assay-specific specificity index.

off_target_binding_detected.descr: Indicates whether measurable off-target binding was observed.

isotype_control_used.descr: Indicates whether an isotype control antibody was included in the assay.

negative_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a negative control sample or cell line was included.

positive_control_used.descr: Indicates whether a positive control antibody or sample was included.

apoptosis_assay_performed.descr: Indicates whether an apoptosis assay was conducted for this record.

apoptosis_percent.descr: Percent of cells classified as apoptotic after antibody treatment, if measured.

apoptosis_assay_method.descr: Method used to measure apoptosis, for example Annexin V/PI staining, caspase activity assay, TUNEL.

proliferation_assay_performed.descr: Indicates whether a proliferation assay was conducted for this record.

proliferation_percent_inhibition.descr: Percent inhibition of cell proliferation relative to control after antibody treatment.

proliferation_assay_method.descr: Method used to measure proliferation, for example MTT, WST-1, CellTiter-Glo, BrdU incorporation.

viability_percent.descr: Percent viable cells after treatment, if measured.

dose_response_curve_fit.descr: Name or identifier of the dose-response model used to estimate affinity or functional potency, for example four-parameter logistic.

replicate_count.descr: Number of technical or biological replicates included for the reported measurement.

mean_value.descr: Mean value of the primary quantitative readout across replicates, in assay-specific units.

std_dev.descr: Standard deviation of the primary quantitative readout across replicates, in assay-specific units.

statistical_test.descr: Statistical test used for comparison, for example t-test, ANOVA, Mann-Whitney U.

p_value.descr: P-value associated with the reported comparison.

lead_candidate.descr: Indicates whether the antibody was prioritized as a lead candidate for further development.

lead_rationale.descr: Short textual rationale for lead selection, for example high affinity, strong specificity, functional activity, or favorable developability.

developability_notes.descr: Free-text notes on developability-relevant observations, such as aggregation, stability, or expression yield.

qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the record passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Notes on quality-control findings or deviations.

publication_or_report_reference.descr: Citation, report identifier, or internal document reference associated with the record.
